## Behavior

Describe the concrete problem, trigger and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List executed checks and results. Identify mocked transport, preflight-only checks, actual inference and human review separately. Explain any check that could not run.

## Review

- [ ] Source media, timing, audio handling and immutable prior versions remain accounted for.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and meaningful regression coverage are updated.
- [ ] Screenshots and fixtures use synthetic or attributed public media.
- [ ] No private media/project names, personal paths, credentials, databases, raw logs or weights are included.

If a change touches LTX conditioning, describe the exact verified backend operation and any remaining runtime limits. A schema or mock test is not an inference result.
